title: Create because its fun
description: Adds create and other addons that I like
body:
I just wanted to create a modpack that had all the mods that I like:
- Create (and addons like jetpack, crafts and additions, connected, and steam and rail)
- Trowel
- Rechiseled
- CTOV (and create compat)
- Travelers Backpack
- Xaero's minimap
  And more
